videobg.mdd: Taking the background out. this time it moves.
videobg.opt.keepAlpha: Keep it transparent (get a PNG sequence)
videobg.status.ready: A {sec}s video. pick a range and try the first frame
videobg.status.badVideo: Could not read that as a video
videobg.status.tried: This is how it looks. if it is fine, cut out all of it
videobg.status.stopped: Stopped. The {n} frames already cut are still usable
videobg.status.savedZip: Saved {n} transparent PNGs as a zip
videobg.status.recording: Playing it back at real speed and recording...
videobg.cost.plain: {n} frames. the model runs once per frame
videobg.cost.capped: {n} frames is the cap. only {sec}s fits. Lower the frames per second for a longer clip
videobg.note.limits: Browsers cannot produce a transparent video file. so this exports either a video on a new background (webm) or a transparent PNG sequence (zip). Sound is not included (frames are captured one by one, so playback never happens). The model runs once per frame, so it takes longer than the clip itself.
